description: Quest+ is a one-time purchase for one quest: premium themes for the recipient and the quest is never deleted. Returns checkoutUrl — give it to the user to open in a browser and pay there (the page first asks them to agree that Quest+ starts right away: it is refundable within 14 days only until the recipient opens the gift); Quest+ turns on by itself once the payment completes (get_quest shows plus: true). Only for quests saved in an account. Fails with payments_disabled when payments are not available, already_plus when the quest has it.
name: buy_quest_plus
title: Get a Quest+ checkout link
